name: prims_ts_dsa_sparse_mla_fp8_h64_d576_k256
description: PrimTS 1CTA DSA sparse MLA decode: packed E4M3 queries attend to the top-k rows of a flat E4M3 [N, 576] KV pool selected per query token; BF16 output.

pool_rows.description: Token rows in the flat KV pool.

block_tables.description: Flat token-row indices (page_id * page_size + offset) of the routed KV rows; -1 marks an empty slot anywhere in the row.

seq_lens.description: Interface parity with trtllm-gen; not read by the kernel.

cum_seq_lens_q.description: Interface parity with trtllm-gen; not read by the kernel.

sparse_mla_top_k_lens.description: Active routing prefix per query token (defaults to the full width).

skip_corr_threshold.description: E4M3 skip-correction threshold in log2 units, in [0, 8].

check:
def standard_check(
    reference_outputs: Any,
    actual_outputs: Any,
    *,
    rtol: Optional[float] = None,
    atol: Optional[float] = None,
    max_mismatch_pct: float = 0.0,
    min_cos_sim: Optional[float] = 1.0 - 1e-3,
) -> bool:
    """Default trace correctness check used when a template does not override it."""
    from flashinfer.trace import default_check

    return default_check(
        reference_outputs,
        actual_outputs,
        rtol=rtol,
        atol=atol,
        max_mismatch_pct=max_mismatch_pct,
        min_cos_sim=min_cos_sim,
    )
